picojpeg v1.1
Author: Rich Geldreich
License: Public domain (see notices in picojpeg.c and picojpeg.h).
Source: https://github.com/richgel999/picojpeg/tree/8ab33a909b4115ace4a952b7ffcb64c350f9298d
Fetched: 2026-10-29
Local changes:
- cc65 JPEG/JPEGBSS overlay segment pragmas.
- Native Y output only; no RGB buffers, chroma IDCT or colour conversion.
- Compact baseline entropy path; consume chroma coefficients without rendering.
- No reduced 1/8 output mode; maximum source dimension 2048.
- Huffman index bounds, canonical tree checks and 8-bit quantization only.
- Propagate DHT/DQT/DRI/variable-marker parser errors to the caller.
- Remove unused optional findEOI function from the compiled port.

mono_jpeg.c supplies bounded input, SOI/EOI checks, viewport scaling and dithering.
The upstream author labels picojpeg.c and picojpeg.h as public domain.
